Ambient noise, the background sounds that fill our environment, can significantly impact our mental health in various ways. At moderate levels, ambient noise can mask more disruptive noises, creating a more pleasant auditory environment that can enhance concentration and productivity. This is often referred to as the "cocktail party effect," where individuals can focus on a single conversation despite surrounding chatter.

However, both too much and too little ambient noise can have negative effects. Excessive noise levels, such as those from traffic, construction, or loud neighbors, can lead to stress, anxiety, and sleep disturbances.
